# .github/pii-patterns.example.txt - template for your PRIVATE leak patterns.
#
# Setup: copy this file to .github/pii-patterns.txt, replace every <placeholder>
# with a real value you must never publish, and NEVER commit the copy (it is
# gitignored; committing it would leak exactly what it lists).
#
# Format: one POSIX extended regex (grep -E) per line. The gate
# (scripts/leak_gate.sh) ignores blank lines and whole-line '#' comments, runs
# every pattern case-insensitively, and matches file contents, file and
# directory names, and the XML inside .docx/.pptx/.xlsx/.zip files.
# Do not put trailing comments on a pattern line: they would become part of the
# regex. Put notes on their own '#' line above it.
# A pattern that must start with '#' is written [#]like-this.
#
# Placeholders below match nothing real until you fill them in.

# Owner identity
\b<owner-first-name>\b
\b<owner-first-name>[ ._-]?<owner-surname>\b
# waive public clone URLs only
<gh-handle>
# any repo under the handle except the template
<gh-handle>/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+
<owner-email-local-part>@
human:<owner-id>

# Household / network
\b<partner-name>\b
\b(<friend-1>|<friend-2>|<contact-1>)\b

# Codename / product
\b<codename-part-1>(&|-and-|-)<codename-part-2>\b
<product-slug>
agent-logs/<product-slug>
\bJA_[A-Z_]+\b
<task-tracker-prefix>-[0-9N]+

# Infra
<prod-hostname>(\.local)?
\b<prod-ssh-alias>(-[a-z0-9]+)?\b
<bridge-checkout-dir>|<tmux-session>|<prod-container-prefix>-[a-z]+-[0-9]
\b(<db-name>|<db-user>)\b
<working-branch>
<launchd-label-prefix>\.
# local home paths: macOS/Linux, Claude Code project slugs, Linux homes
/Users/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/
-Users-[A-Za-z0-9._-]+-
/home/[a-z0-9._-]+/

# Private repos / ventures / employers / clients / places
\b(<private-repo-1>|<private-repo-2>|<archive-repo>|<engagement-repo>)\b
\b(<venture>|<engagement-brand-1>|<engagement-brand-2>|<employer-1>|<client-1>)\b
\b(<home-city>|<relocation-city>|<region>)\b
<personal-demo-host>\.pages\.dev

# Comms and run ids
[Tt]elegram [0-9]{3,6}\b
[#]<private-slack-channel>
[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}
session:[0-9a-f-]{8,}
commit:[0-9a-f]{7,40}

# Third-party names
<third-party-review-company>
<council-persona-1>|<council-persona-2>

# Secrets
\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}
github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}
xox[abp]-[0-9A-Za-z-]{20,}
[0-9]{8,10}:AA[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}
eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}
hc-ping\.com/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}
[A-Za-z_]*(api_?key|authkey|secret|password|token)["']?[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*["']?[^[:space:]"']{8,}
